graft_verdict_html: The graft verdict reverses at the right injection point. Round 2's input-channel graft died because EASE's signal was pushed through the same encoder that destroys item-item detail in the first place; injected after the bottleneck, it works. The gate variant (logits += softplus(w·z)·z(EASE), one learned scalar per user from the latent) reaches median rank 39 at full context vs the control's 58 — nearly closing the gap to standalone EASE's 36 — while staying control-equal at k8/k16. The concat variant is close behind on raw ranking (46) and slightly ahead on the value metrics (filtered r@250 0.774 vs 0.768, novelty-q4 0.602 vs 0.582). Three properties make this the most promising integration path so far: (1) no franchise inflation — top-10 franchise share 0.42/0.45 vs the control's 0.39, where naive EASE sits at 0.51 and the post-hoc blend at 0.65+; joint training lets the decoder absorb EASE's mid-band signal without its pathology. (2) EASE's dead deep-tail is fixed — filtered tail recall 0.35 vs standalone EASE's 0.04; the NN pathway keeps serving the tail while the residual serves the mid. (3) The gate discovered the serving policy we derived by hand — its learned weight rises monotonically with context size (0.007 at k8 → 0.109 at full profile), which is round 2's "w→0 for small profiles" schedule, found by SGD instead of a sweep. The post-hoc blend still leads on deep-tail (0.435) and novelty-q4 (0.674) at full context, at the cost of franchise-heavy raw lists, a hand-tuned schedule, and a knob re-fit — the two paths are not mutually exclusive (a light blend on top of a graft model is untested). Confirmed with a second seed: gate seed-2 replicates everything load-bearing — medrank 38 / r@50 0.540 (seed-1: 39 / 0.540), filtered r@250 0.765 vs 0.768, franchise share identical at 0.42, and the learned schedule reproduces (0.008 → 0.108 vs 0.007 → 0.109). Remaining caveats: concat is single-run, one B (λ=200) is shared by training and eval, and a graft model's logits are no longer pure lift — the EASE residual re-introduces popularity correlation, so the (α,k) knob remap needs re-examination before this ships.
implications4_html:
Where round 4 leaves the program

  • The battery is the new standard harness. Franchise-filtered band recall at matched filtered overall is the headline; novelty-q4, filtered top-10 pop rank/novelty, and unfiltered k8/k16 (interactive guard) are the diagnostics; raw overall recall is a guardrail only. Every future model comparison should run probe_value_eval.py — it caught both EASE's popularity-list failure and the grafts' clean wins with one protocol.
  • Bottleneck axis closed in both directions. Don't shrink below 512 (real degradation), don't widen (reconstruction-only gains, generalization slightly worse, ranking flat). The dec-era "capacity moved nothing" result and round 2's "bottleneck" framing are reconciled: the constraint is the sum-pooling encoder, which no latent width fixes.
  • Two live integration paths, both needing B (~72MB bf16) at inference. Path A, serving-layer adaptive blend: biggest deep-tail/novelty numbers, but filter-dependent, hand-scheduled, knob re-fit required. Path B, graft retrain (gate or concat): one model, learned scheduling, no franchise inflation, most of the filtered-overall win, cold start untouched — and it slots into the existing single-model serving interface. Path B is the cleaner product change; A+B can stack.
  • Open before any prod decision: concat second seed (gate is confirmed: 38/39 medrank, identical franchise share and schedule across seeds); graft × (α,k) semantics (graft logits aren't pure lift — measure ρ(logits, pop) and re-fit the knob linearization); sentinel eyeballs of graft lists; the round-3 temporal-fixture guardrail, which now applies to grafts too.
  • The interactive recommender is safe in every path — grafts are control-equal at k8–k16 and the gate self-attenuates there; no backup mechanism needed.
